gloss_en: mittah — a bed (the sleeping/marital couch, as in placing one's bed between north and south), symbolizing marital union (zivug); not matteh (staff/rod or tribe)

outliers.actual_gloss_en: matteh — a staff/rod (Moses' staff, 'staff of Your strength'), symbolizing the dominion and power of the tzaddik
outliers.reason: Vocalized מַטֶּה (staff), not מִטָּה (bed); explicitly Moses' staff subduing enemies — a homograph of the bed sense.

outliers.actual_gloss_en: matteh — a staff/rod ('staff of bread', Lev 26:26; also tribe), symbolizing sustenance/parnassah
outliers.reason: Vocalized מַטֶּה; the text itself distinguishes 'also matteh is the aspect of sustenance' from mittah=zivug — different word, staff not bed.
